description: The product catalog is the core registry of all inventory items. This PRD covers the catalog browse page at /app/catalog with a data table showing all items, a filter bar for narrowing results by category, supplier, stock status, and location, column sorting, pagination (20 items per page), and the full create/edit item form. The table displays key columns: name, SKU, category, quantity on hand (with status badge), location, and supplier. Items are sourced from demo store hooks. Admin and Manager roles can create, edit, and delete items. Requestors can only browse. The create/edit form is a side-sheet with all item fields organized in logical sections.

stories.title: Catalog data table component
stories.description: Create src/components/catalog/CatalogTable.tsx — a data table using the shadcn Table component. Columns: checkbox (for bulk select), Name (with small image thumbnail if available), SKU (font-mono), Category, Qty on Hand (font-mono, with StatusBadge inline), Location, Supplier. Table has sticky header, alternating row hover, and click handler on rows (for detail view, wired later). Pagination controls at bottom showing 'Showing 1-20 of 35 items' with prev/next buttons. 20 items per page. Data comes from useItems() hook.
acceptanceCriteria: Table renders all columns: checkbox, name, SKU, category, qty, location, supplier
SKU and qty use font-mono
StatusBadge shown inline with quantity (green/amber/red based on threshold)
Sticky header on scroll
Row hover state with subtle background change
Pagination: 20 per page, prev/next buttons, item count display
Empty state if no items: 'No items in catalog'
Responsive: horizontally scrollable on mobile
Component under 250 lines

verification.test: Enter demo mode, navigate to /app/catalog. Table renders with 20 items on first page. Pagination shows 'Showing 1-20 of 35'. Click next — shows remaining items. SKUs in monospace. Status badges visible. Resize to 390px — table scrolls horizontally. No console errors.

stories.title: Catalog filter bar
stories.description: Create src/components/catalog/CatalogFilters.tsx — a horizontal filter bar above the table. Filters: Category (Select dropdown populated from useCategories), Supplier (Select dropdown from useSuppliers), Stock Status (Select: All, In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock), Location (Select from useLocations top-level). A search input for name/SKU text search. A 'Clear Filters' button that resets all. Filters apply client-side by passing filter params to useItems(). On mobile, filters collapse into a 'Filters' button that opens a sheet with all filter options.
acceptanceCriteria: 4 filter dropdowns: Category, Supplier, Status, Location
Text search input for name/SKU filtering
Filters apply immediately on change
Clear Filters button resets all to default
Filtered results update table and pagination
Mobile: filters collapse into sheet triggered by 'Filters' button
Filter state reflected in active filter count badge on mobile button
Component under 200 lines

verification.test: Enter demo mode, /app/catalog. Select a category filter — table shows only items in that category. Select 'Low Stock' status — only low stock items shown. Type a partial name in search — matching items displayed. Click 'Clear Filters' — all items restored. Resize to 390px — filter bar collapses to button, opens as sheet. No console errors.

stories.title: Catalog column sorting
stories.description: Add sorting to CatalogTable. Clickable column headers for Name, SKU, Qty, Category, Supplier toggle between ascending, descending, and unsorted. A small arrow icon indicates current sort direction. Only one column sorted at a time. Default sort: Name ascending. Sorting works with current filter state (sort the filtered results).
acceptanceCriteria: Clickable column headers with sort indicators
Click cycles: ascending → descending → unsorted
Arrow icon shows sort direction
Only one active sort at a time
Default: Name ascending
Sorting works on filtered results
Pagination resets to page 1 on sort change

verification.test: Enter demo mode, /app/catalog. Click 'Name' header — items sort A-Z (arrow up). Click again — Z-A (arrow down). Click 'Qty' header — sorts by quantity, Name sort clears. Apply a filter, then sort — sorting works on filtered subset. No console errors.

stories.title: Create item form — side sheet
stories.description: Create src/components/catalog/ItemFormSheet.tsx — a Sheet (sliding from right) containing the full item creation/edit form. Form sections: Basic Info (name, description, SKU, barcode, image URL), Classification (category dropdown, tags multi-input, unit of measure), Stock Settings (reorder threshold, reorder quantity), Pricing (cost per unit, sale price), Assignment (preferred supplier dropdown, location dropdown), Status (active/discontinued/archived radio). Use react-hook-form with zod validation. Required fields: name, SKU. SKU must be unique (check against existing items). Form has Save and Cancel buttons in footer.
acceptanceCriteria: Sheet slides from right, 480px wide on desktop, full-width on mobile
Form organized in labeled sections
All item fields present with appropriate input types
Category and supplier as searchable dropdowns
Tags as comma-separated text input or multi-chip input
Zod validation: name required, SKU required and unique
Validation errors shown inline
Save button calls useCreateItem or useUpdateItem mutation
Cancel closes sheet without saving
Loading state on save button during mutation
Form under 250 lines (extract section components if needed)

verification.test: Enter demo mode, open catalog. Trigger new item sheet. Fill in name and SKU, leave others default. Save — new item appears in table. Open sheet again, enter duplicate SKU — validation error. Cancel — sheet closes, no item created. Fill all fields, save — item created with all data. No console errors.

stories.notes: May need to split form sections into sub-components if over 250 lines

stories.title: Edit item via form sheet
stories.description: Extend ItemFormSheet to support edit mode. When opened with an existing item ID, pre-populate all form fields with the item's current data. Title changes from 'New Item' to 'Edit Item'. Save calls useUpdateItem mutation instead of create. Add an 'Edit' button/icon to each table row (visible only to admin/manager via PermissionGate). Clicking Edit opens the sheet in edit mode for that item.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit button on table rows (admin/manager only)
Sheet opens pre-populated with item data
Title shows 'Edit Item' in edit mode
Save updates existing item, not creates new
Updated data reflects in table immediately
Requestor role: no edit button visible
SKU uniqueness check excludes current item's own SKU

verification.test: Enter demo mode, /app/catalog. Click edit on first item. Sheet opens with pre-filled data. Change the name, save. Table shows updated name. Verify SKU field still allows the item's own SKU. Switch to requestor role — edit buttons disappear. No console errors.

stories.title: Delete item with confirmation
stories.description: Add delete functionality for items. Add a delete option in the row actions (three-dot menu or action column). Clicking delete opens an AlertDialog confirmation: 'Delete [Item Name]? This action cannot be undone. All movement history for this item will be preserved but the item will be marked as archived.' Confirm calls useDeleteItem (or useUpdateItem to set status=archived). Only admin role can delete. Manager can archive but not hard-delete.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete/archive option in row actions menu
AlertDialog confirmation with item name
Confirm archives the item (sets status to 'archived')
Archived items disappear from default view (unless filtered)
Only admin sees delete option
Manager sees 'Archive' option instead
Requestor sees no action menu
Toast confirmation after successful deletion/archive

verification.test: Enter demo mode (admin). Click actions menu on an item. Click 'Delete'. Confirmation dialog appears with item name. Click confirm — item disappears from table, toast shown. Item count decreases by 1. No console errors.

stories.title: New Item button and page header
stories.description: Add page header to /app/catalog with: 'Product Catalog' heading, item count subtitle ('35 items'), and a '+ New Item' button (teal primary, admin/manager only via PermissionGate). Clicking opens the ItemFormSheet in create mode. On mobile, the button should be a floating action button (FAB) in bottom-right corner instead of in the header.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Product Catalog' heading with item count
'+ New Item' button in header (admin/manager only)
Button opens ItemFormSheet in create mode

Mobile: button as FAB in bottom-right
FAB uses amber accent for visibility

verification.test: Enter demo mode, /app/catalog. Page heading shows 'Product Catalog' with count. '+ New Item' button visible. Click it — form sheet opens in create mode. Resize to 390px — FAB visible in bottom-right. Switch to requestor — button/FAB disappear. No console errors.

stories.title: Catalog page composition
stories.description: Compose the full /app/catalog page in src/routes/app.catalog.tsx. Layout: page header (US-07-007), filter bar (US-07-002), data table (US-07-001) with sorting (US-07-003). Manage state: current filters, sort column/direction, current page, selected item for sheet. Wire the ItemFormSheet for create and edit. Set page head title to 'Catalog — Stackwise'.
acceptanceCriteria: All catalog components composed in correct order
Filter → sort → paginate pipeline works correctly
Create and edit flows functional via sheet
Page title 'Catalog — Stackwise'
State resets appropriately (filters reset pagination, etc.)
Smooth UX: no layout jumps on filter/sort/page changes

verification.test: Enter demo mode, /app/catalog. Full page renders: header, filters, table. Filter by category — table updates, pagination resets. Sort by name — works on filtered results. Create new item — appears in table. Edit item — changes persist. Everything flows smoothly. No console errors.
